hint_ladder: Warn the listener that you are about to disagree with them.
Use the phrase at the front of the sentence, before the comma.
Start with the words: ___, I think the numbers are wrong.
teaching_content.reveal_form: With all due respect, I think the numbers are wrong.
canonical_forms: With all due respect, I think the numbers are wrong.
alternative_realizations: With all due respect, that is not what the report says.
